$comment: ADR-060 §3.5 — the single trust algebra: effective behavior = knob tier × caller band. This file pins the caller-band axis: how an Eternitas EI score (EI_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.v1, windy-cloud DNA v0.2.0) maps onto the fleet's band vocabulary (windy-agent Capability Plane: SANDBOX/USER/TRUSTED/OWNER), and what each band may do with each tier. Additive → v1.1 via PR; breaking → v2 and tell Grant.

invariants.$comment: No band, no autonomy level, no combination overrides these.
invariants.always_confirm_floor: Tools tiered always_confirm (money actions, apply_update, reset_to_defaults, run_shell) confirm on EVERY invocation for EVERY band — no session grants, no autonomy override.
invariants.no_self_escalation: A standing grant is given by the USER via the confirmer; an agent can never grant itself one.
invariants.structured_denial: A denial returns {ok:false, error:'denied'} — never silence.
invariants.discovery_filtering: A caller below a tool's band_floor never sees the tool in tools/list — gating starts at discovery, not invocation.

bands.ei_range: no EPT, or EPT with EI < 400
bands.sees: nothing by default (the stinky-bot treatment — ADR-060 §0); a surface MAY expose get_health alone to sandbox callers as a mercy knob

bands.ei_range: EPT in good standing, EI 400-699 — or local co-tenant on a Class D machine (human present, install token held)

tiers.ask_first: confirm per call; user MAY grant session always-allow

bands.sees: USER + lifecycle knobs (restart_app, safe mode, reconnect chains) + update knobs

tiers.ask_first: execute under a standing user grant, else confirm

bands.ei_range: EI >= 900, bound to the owning wi_ account — velocity multiplier x10 per EI_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.v1

tiers.always_confirm: confirm per call — yes, even the owner

band_floor_defaults.$comment: Applied when a manifest tool omits band_floor.

confirmation_transport.desktop: voice or tap via the product confirmer (windytalk hands/tiers.py pattern)
confirmation_transport.cloud: CONFIRM_FLOW.v1 — single-use HMAC tokens, voice-yes first-class, composite bundles = one yes
confirmation_transport.agent-host: conversational confirm in-channel (windy-agent pattern); /permit-style block-and-wait is a future addition, not assumed
